// pos: inline `:=` assignments as expressions (original parexpr piece):
// the value is the NEW content; right-associative; nested sequences.
function main()
    local x
    local y
    x := ( y := 10, y )
    ? x
    ? y
    x := ( ( y := ( 1, 2, 3 ) ), y * ( 10, 20, 30 ) )
    ? x
    ? y
    return nil

rows.name: t1371_parexpr_if_seqcond
rows.source:
// pos: block IF with a parenthesized comma-sequence condition (one
// top-level comma is NOT inline IIF); NIL-only call as a discarded
// sequence element; single parenthesized inline assignment condition.
function something(x, y, z)
    return nil
function main()
    local x
    local y
    IF ( y := .T. )
        ? "Working"
    ENDIF
    IF ( x := 10, y := ( x == 10 ) )
        ? "Working"
        ? x, y
    ENDIF
    IF ( something(1, 2, 3), .T. )
        ? "Working"
    ENDIF
    return nil
